qualification: Same development APK on two separately owned arm64 API 36 AVDs. Each began with one genuine Android browser sign-in, verified session and cold online reopen.

testSetup.backend: Exact confirmed-session FieldLog service from Git blob b6debbc45f8ab96360d2d494e376d80ea5f6abf7.
testSetup.outage: Remove the only device reverse mapping to port 8765, verify it is absent and launch after force-stop. Match exact workspace and credential bytes and compare service route inventory.
testSetup.expiry: Override only the disposable backend's issued session lifetime to 70 seconds. Force-stop while the credential still exists and the deadline is in the future. Cold-launch with the device route absent after the actual confirmed wall-clock deadline.
